# LG ThinQ payloads (30)

Payloads in the shapes LG's ThinQ Connect API sends: the `response` of `GET /devices` and
`GET /devices/{id}/state`, and MQTT push messages. They follow LG's developer docs and its
SDK (`thinqconnect` 1.0.x, read 2026-10-31); they aren't captures from the family's own
appliances. When the real washer and dryer are linked, a captured payload that differs
belongs here, with a test.
